globals.doc: Port Scan Detection Engineering Lab - Splunk Dashboard

dashboard.label: Port Scan Detection - Live Monitor
dashboard.description: Real-time monitoring and detection of reconnaissance port scanning activities

panels.label: Total Blocked Connections (Last 1h)
panels.description: Total number of blocked connection attempts in the last hour

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "[UFW BLOCK]" earliest=-1h | stats count

panels.label: Unique Source IPs
panels.description: Number of unique source IPs generating port scan activity

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "[UFW BLOCK]" earliest=-1h | stats dc(SRC)

panels.label: High Risk Alerts
panels.description: Number of detections meeting high-risk criteria (>20 ports)

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "SYN" earliest=-1h | stats dc(DPT) as unique_ports by SRC | where unique_ports > 20 | stats count

panels.label: Most Active Scanning IP
panels.description: Single source IP with highest activity

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "[UFW BLOCK]" earliest=-1h | stats count by SRC | sort - count | head 1 | fields SRC

panels.label: Top 10 Scanning Source IPs
panels.description: Source IPs with the most scanning activity

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "[UFW BLOCK]" earliest=-1h | stats count as attempts, dc(DPT) as unique_ports by SRC | sort - attempts | head 10
index=firewall sourcetype=syslog earliest=-1h | stats count by tcp_flags

panels.label: Top 15 Most Targeted Ports
panels.description: Destination ports that are most frequently scanned

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "[UFW BLOCK]" earliest=-1h | stats count as scan_attempts by DPT | sort - scan_attempts | head 15

panels.label: Scan Activity Timeline (by Hour)
panels.description: When scanning activity occurs throughout the day

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "[UFW BLOCK]" earliest=-24h | timechart count by _time span=1h

panels.label: SYN Scan Alerts - High Risk
panels.description: All SYN scans where source hit > 20 unique ports

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "SYN" earliest=-1h | stats count as attempts, dc(DPT) as unique_ports, values(DPT) as port_list by SRC | where unique_ports > 20 | eval severity="HIGH" | table SRC, unique_ports, attempts, severity | sort - unique_ports

index=firewall sourcetype=syslog ("FIN" OR "NONE" OR "FIN,PSH,URG") earliest=-1h | stats count as packets, dc(DPT) as unique_ports by SRC, tcp_flags | eval severity="MEDIUM" | table SRC, tcp_flags, unique_ports, packets, severity | sort - packets

panels.label: Port Sweep Detection - Multiple Targets
panels.description: Single source scanning same port across multiple destination IPs

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "[UFW BLOCK]" earliest=-1h | stats count as attempts, dc(DST) as unique_targets by SRC, DPT | where unique_targets > 15 | eval severity="HIGH" | table SRC, DPT, unique_targets, attempts, severity | sort - unique_targets

panels.label: Detailed Firewall Events - Last 100
panels.description: Raw firewall logs for detailed investigation

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "[UFW" earliest=-1h | fields _time, SRC, DST, DPT, tcp_flags | head 100

panels.label: SYN Scan Activity - Real-Time Trend
panels.description: Timeline of SYN scan attempts (last 4 hours)

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog "SYN" earliest=-4h | timechart count by SRC, span=5m

panels.label: Source IPs with Multi-Technique Scans
panels.description: Advanced attackers using multiple scan methods

query.querystring: index=firewall sourcetype=syslog earliest=-1h | stats values(tcp_flags) as techniques by SRC | search techniques="*SYN*" techniques="*FIN*" | table SRC, techniques

metadata.author: SOC Detection Engineer
metadata.notes: Use this dashboard to monitor and investigate port scanning reconnaissance activity
setup_instructions: 1. Export this JSON and save as splunk_dashboard.json
2. In Splunk UI: Settings > Dashboards > Create New > Import
4. Adjust index name to match your firewall logs index
5. Adjust source type if different from 'syslog'
6. Customize field names (SRC, DST, DPT, tcp_flags) to match your environment
7. Set up alerts on high-risk panels (SYN scan > 20 ports)
8. Configure alert actions: Email, Slack, webhook, PagerDuty

alert_rules.name: Stealth Scan Detected
alert_rules.condition: FIN or NULL or XMAS packets

alert_rules.name: Port Sweep Detected
alert_rules.action: Block source IP, escalate to security team

performance_tuning: Use time picker to limit search scope
Pre-compute SYN scans with summary indexing
Implement lookup tables for IP reputation
